    "May lack advanced customization for complex design workflows",

  "overall_experience": "This graphic designer likely finds Basecamp to be a highly effective tool for managing their creative projects, particularly for file organization and facilitating feedback within their 51-200 person design team. The platform's ease of use and ability to keep projects on track are appreciated, especially over two years of consistent use. While generally positive, some frustrations might arise from notification management and the desire for deeper integrations or more granular customization to fit specific design-centric needs."
